binding_findings.hmlr_title_uprn_route: National Polygon.Title_No -> Title Number and UPRN Look Up.Title_No -> UPRN is the documented deterministic cadastral identity route when licensed data and trusted Title_No are available.
binding_findings.hmlr_access: Full NPS is chargeable; free sample requires account and licence acceptance, therefore held under no-account/no-payment policy.
binding_findings.inspire_limit: Free INSPIRE polygons cover registered freehold property and expose Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, not direct public UPRN crosswalk.
binding_findings.os_linked_limit: OS UPRN-TOID relationship is authoritative feature linkage but point-in-polygon/version confidence does not itself establish legal parcel ownership.
